race.comment: CRADLE OF JAZZ (3) battled away bravely for fourth at Halidon 6 weeks ago on a track that was firmer than she prefers. She has not missed a cheque in 3 starts around this circuit, including 2 wins, and will be trying 2541m for the first time. A wet track will help her, and if she sees out the trip, will be the one to beat. SUIT OF WANDS (8) may not win often, but is very consistent at this level. He gave a great sight in front over a similar trip at Murray Bridge in his penultimate start before fading late to finish fourth. He too would like some cut in the ground, so keep him very safe in all combos. ARUGAMAMA (2) has needed all of her 4 starts this prep to get fit, and there should be improvement in her out to this trip. Each way value. GIRLS GIRLS GIRLS (10) capped off some good form with a well deserved win at Gawler over 2121m last time out, and she has won over this distance in the past. Stick with her. RETOURNE (5) won't lack fitness, and is worth including.
